segments.say: Chess rule number one. Black's rook attacks b1, a square White's rook has to cross. Can White castle queenside? Decide now.
segments.caption: Castle through attacked b1?

segments.say: Yes! Only the squares the king walks over matter: e1, d1 and c1. The b1 square doesn't count.
Did you know this? Rule number 2 drops tomorrow. Subscribe so you don't miss it.
segments.caption: Rule #2 tomorrow!
